prompts.title: A Miniature with Chocolate
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic macro portrait of the uploaded handsome person transformed into a tiny, cute chibi-style miniature. Maintain the recognizable facial identity and glasses if present. Give the miniature an oversized semi-realistic head, a very small body, chibi body proportions, and extremely short hands and legs, while keeping the face cute and adorable.
Show the miniature standing on an off-white round tabletop and tightly hugging an extra-oversized red KitKat bar that is significantly taller and wider than his entire body. Both tiny arms should wrap firmly around the chocolate bar as if he refuses to let it go. The KitKat must look like a real wrapped chocolate bar with natural crumpled folds, a torn-open top, and partially eaten chocolate fingers clearly showing crisp wafer layers.
Add realistic chocolate smudges around his mouth, across his fingertips, and on both hands, suggesting he was just eating it. A huge realistic human hand enters from the upper-right corner, gently pinching the back collar of his jacket without covering his face or the KitKat.
Dress him in a dark navy hoodie, white T-shirt, dark slim-fit jeans, and clean matching sneakers. Give him a playful, lovable smile while looking directly at the camera.
Use a tight vertical 4:5 macro composition where the oversized head, miniature, and enormous KitKat dominate the frame. Add a few chocolate crumbs and small melted chocolate drops on the tabletop. Use a soft light-grey bokeh background, soft bright studio lighting, shallow depth of field, outfit texture, and chocolate textures, natural wrapper reflections, and a whimsical premium advertising-photography aesthetic. Avoid adult body proportions, simple background and realistic head.

prompts.title: Yellow Scooter Escape
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic, surreal, humorous action scene with a caricature-style perspective. Capturing a comedic yet high-stakes chase moment in a realistic tropical rural environment with slightly exaggerated character expression.

Face Match & Identity Preservation
Use the provided reference image for strict face matching. Preserve identical facial structure, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle/hairline, glasses shape, and overall identity. Maintain natural skin texture; no beautification or facial alteration.
Central Subject
Subject is riding a vintage scooter slightly left direction of frame, while panicking intensely — mouth wide open, eyes bulging behind thick black circular glasses, eyebrows raised, wind-blown hair swept upward and backward. 
The subject wears an olive-green bomber jacket over a blue crew-neck t-shirt, dark denim jeans, and neutral casual sneakers, with clothing naturally flapping and pulled backward by the wind to emphasize speed.
Vehicle
Vintage yellow Vespa-style scooter with glossy paint reflections and chrome headlight details. Strong sense of speed and forward force.
Aggressive Pursuit (Important)
Three street dogs (tan, black, and white/cream) chase aggressively right behind the scooter in full sprint:

bodies stretched in running stride (mid-air gallop moments)
ears back, intense focus on the rider
open mouths with visible teeth and tongues
“attack-chase” energy, close distance, high urgency
High-Speed Motion & Effects (Important)
Emphasize high-speed movement with smooth cinematic motion blur:

subtle motion blur on the road edges, dust trail, background palms, and distant fields
keep the man + scooter sharp (hero focus), dogs mostly sharp with slight limb motion blur
strong volumetric dust cloud kicked up by rear tire and dogs’ paws, forming a long trailing plume
speed lines NOT cartoon lines — realistic motion blur and dust streaking
Environment & Lighting
Narrow winding dirt road through neon-green rice paddy fields, scattered tall coconut palm trees, bright midday sun, pale blue sky with soft wispy clouds. High-key cinematic HDR lighting with realistic shadows and crisp highlights on the scooter.
Composition
One-point perspective with the dirt road as leading lines toward the subject. Shallow depth of field: sharp foreground/mid-ground, softly blurred distant palms and horizon.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical
Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, surreal action, caricature-style, high detail, realistic motion blur, dynamic chase storytelling

prompts.title: Wacky Tricycle Rides
prompts.prompt:
Identity Reference (Strict)

Use the uploaded photo as a strict identity reference.

The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline, and expression style must remain 100% identical to the reference.
No beautification, no reshaping, no stylization, no identity drift.
Main Concept
Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic, surreal action scene with a playful, caricature-style perspective.
A subject riding a tiny mini tricycle at high speed down a road.

The camera is placed at an ultra-low angle using a wide-angle/fisheye lens, creating a dramatic, exaggerated perspective.
Foreground & Perspective
The bare right foot is in the extreme foreground.
It appears enormous, occupying a large portion of the frame.
The sole shows hyper-realistic texture: skin folds, pores, natural wrinkles, subtle dirt and highlights.
Subject Appearance
Large glasses
Hair blown back by the wind
Extremely exaggerated expression:
Mouth wide open in surprise/amusement
Eyes wide and expressive
The face must match the reference exactly.
Companion
A small dog runs beside him (use the uploaded reference if provided):

Playful expression
Tongue sticking out
Matching the speed of the tricycle
Environment & Motion
Open road
Dramatic sky with dense, cinematic clouds
Strong directional cinematic lighting
Heavy motion blur in the background to emphasize speed
Subject and foreground remain sharp
Style & Quality
Hyper-realistic with surreal, humorous proportions
Cinematic lighting
Shallow depth of field
Ultra-detailed textures
8K clarity, high sharpness
Aspect ratio 4:5
Negative Prompt
Facial deformities, face different from reference, identity drift, low resolution, blur, incorrect anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate or missing feet, distorted hands, flat lighting, simple cartoon style, low quality.
